## Activity

During August 2026, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 35 captures. This activity represents the total number of image sets recorded at the site during the month. The service continued routine capture activity, with the completed work available for subsequent image-quality review and grading.

## Image quality

Of the 35 captures, 2 were marked ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 5.7. The ungradable images could not proceed through the standard grading process. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 16 referable results from the captures assessed. These results require the appropriate follow-up under the relevant clinical pathway. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 1 days. This measure provides an indication of the time taken for images to move through the grading process during August 2026.
